Q8543.reason: Postprandial RUQ/epigastric pain radiating to the scapula after a fatty meal in an obese patient is biliary colic; RUQ ultrasound is the first-line test.

Q8548.reason: Hart’s point is that legal validity does not settle obedience, so an unjust law still requires moral scrutiny and creates no automatic moral duty to obey.

Q8549.reason: Hours-long episodic vertigo with fluctuating hearing loss, tinnitus, and aural fullness is the classic Meniere triad; BPPV is seconds-long and acoustic neuroma is progressive.
